question: By what means does the unfolding of higher knowledge occur according to this teaching?
premises: The unfolding of knowledge is said to occur.
It occurs in this prescribed manner.
It does not occur through other forms of service.
inference: The unfolding of knowledge arises through this practice and not through other service.
plain_english: O fair one, the unfolding of knowledge arises in this way, not by any other service.
